metadata.title: Trimatech Games - Roblox games and Studio plugins
metadata.description: A one-person Roblox studio in Tallinn, Estonia. Six games on Roblox, thirteen plugins on the Creator Store, all built with TypeScript and React through roblox-ts.
metadata.ogAlt: Trimatech Games - Roblox games and Studio plugins
metadata.twitterAlt: Trimatech Games - Roblox games and Studio plugins

hero.heading: Roblox games, and the Studio tools we wished existed.
hero.description: A one-person studio in Tallinn, Estonia. We ship games on Roblox and publish the plugins we build along the way, all written in TypeScript and React through roblox-ts.

mission.heading: Bring web-grade engineering to Roblox, and ship games people come back to.
mission.description: Most Roblox projects are built in one Studio window with no version control and no tests. We build ours like a web product, and we publish the tools and the guide so other developers can do the same.

games.title: Games first
games.text: Every plugin on this page started as something one of our own games needed. The games keep the tools honest.

tools.title: One chore, one click, one undo
tools.text: Each plugin solves a single Studio chore. Preview before you commit, apply in one undo step, nothing hidden and no remote code.

engineering.title: Built like a web app
engineering.text: TypeScript, React, Git and CI, compiled to Luau with roblox-ts. The starter kit we use is open source, so React developers can skip the setup pain.

mission.starterLink: Open the roblox-ts starter on GitHub

games.heading: Six games, one developer
games.description: Everything here is live on Roblox. Visit counts come straight from the Roblox API and refresh hourly.

slash-for-brainrots.tagline: Slice everything in your way, stack Slice power with every swing, free the brainrots and escape eight worlds.

outfits-on-a-budget.tagline: Set a Robux budget and a solver picks the best full outfit you can buy. Vote on other players' looks, then wear yours in-game.

territory-takeover.tagline: Draw boundary lines to claim the biggest share of a circular arena while dodging everyone else. Controller support included.

dead-end-road.tagline: Hold the streets against zombie waves on foot or behind the wheel. Kills pay cash, and everything you buy stays yours.

city-states.tagline: Zone homes and factories, lay roads and rail, then walk the streets you built at human scale. A heavy prototype, not for potato devices.

dunkeep.tagline: Dig an underground empire, command workers and soldiers, lay traps and research spells. Early alpha.

plugins.heading: Thirteen plugins on the Creator Store
plugins.description: Building tools for Roblox Studio, each one shaped by a real job inside our own games. Open any of them on the Creator Store.

click-to-build.tagline: Roads, walls, fences and more: hover for a live preview, click to place. No dragging or rotating by hand.

city-builder.tagline: Auto-layout models in 3D, like Figma constraints for parts, plus generators for roads, zones and skyscrapers.

perf-auditor.tagline: Scan a place for performance problems, get a 0 to 100 score, select offenders in one click and fix many of them in one undo.

super-aligner.tagline: Align, distribute and arrange parts and models along any axis. The tools Studio's own Align Tool is missing.

terrain-tools.tagline: Shape terrain around anything you build. Preview see-through, apply in one undo step.

voxelizer.tagline: Turn any part, model or union into voxels, as separate blocks or a generated mesh, with true colors from your textures.

icon-snap.tagline: Batch-screenshot hundreds of models into transparent PNG icons, named after each model and saved to disk.

quick-actions.tagline: Keep small Luau snippets with a name and icon, run them on your selection, or pin them to the toolbar.

material-picker.tagline: Pick color, material and texture from one part and paint it onto others with a click.

npc-outfit-creator.tagline: Build NPC outfits from Marketplace asset IDs with a live rig preview and saved presets. No HumanoidDescription editing.

grip-a-tool.tagline: See how a Tool sits in a character's hand, tune the grip CFrame and preview it during animation playback.

pose-a-dude.tagline: Place characters frozen at any animation frame as building elements, statues or frame-by-frame sequences.

drop-a-dude.tagline: A scale-reference character that follows your camera and cleans itself up when you close the plugin.

contact.heading: Say hi
contact.description: Bug reports, collaboration ideas, or a plugin you wish existed. One person reads everything.

detail.getOnStore: Get it on the Creator Store

slash-for-brainrots.intro: A ninja escape simulator. Slice through walls, cages and guards, stack +1 Slice with every swing, and free the brainrots locked up around each world so they earn cash for you around the clock. The Slash Training update adds booths where you slice flying fruit, chain combos, dodge bombs and climb booth leaderboards for SlashPoints.
features: Eight worlds to escape from
Better swords mean bigger slices
Mythic, Secret and GOD brainrots to hunt
Training booths with combos, bombs and leaderboards
SlashPoints buy Blade Power upgrades
Redeemable codes, with a new one unlocked every 100 likes

outfits-on-a-budget.intro: Set a Robux budget and a solver picks the best complete outfit you can afford, counting the items you already own as free. Fine-tune any slot by hand, roll a random look for inspiration, and swipe through other players' outfits. Everything you find is purchasable and wearable without leaving the game.
features: Budget solver that knows what you already own
Edit every slot by hand or randomize the lot
Public gallery with voting, and the game learns your style
Buy and wear the outfit directly in-game

territory-takeover.intro: A strategy arena for a handful of players. Draw boundary lines out from your territory to claim sections of a large circular arena, and stay away from everyone else while you do it. Powerups turn the tide when you are behind.
features: Claim the largest share of the circle
Balance offense and defense each round
Powerups to outsmart opponents
Full controller support
Still in active development, feedback welcome

dead-end-road.intro: The city fell. Hold the streets against waves of zombies with your friends, on foot or behind the wheel. Kills pay cash, and cash buys guns, upgrades, cars and car weapons that stay yours for good. Ammo, fuel, repair kits and bandages run out, so loot them off zombies, finish missions and carry a bigger backpack.
features: Co-op zombie survival in a premade city
Drive any unlocked car straight through the horde
Permanent purchases: guns, upgrades, cars, car weapons and backpack space
Consumables run out and have to be looted or earned
Missions that pay

city-states.intro: Build a realistic city at real size, then go down and live in it. Zone homes, shops and factories, lay roads and rail, run the power lines and watch people move in. Your avatar walks the same streets the traffic drives on. Each city has one mayor, and friends can join while you build to cruise around or cause mayhem.
features: Zoning, roads, rail and power lines
Human-scale streets you can walk and drive
Zombie waves in the streets you built
Roll a gun up outside the limits and bombard any city, yours or someone else's
Shared world map with plots to claim and other cities to visit
A heavy prototype, not made for weak devices

dunkeep.intro: A real-time strategy game set under the surface. Dig tunnels, construct rooms, manage your creatures and fortify the dungeon with traps and spells. Mine gold, unearth gems and find hidden treasure deeper underground, research technology and manufacture your own equipment.
features: Design and expand an underground fortress room by room
Command Workers, Soldiers, Scientists and specialist creatures
Traps and spells against intruders
Research and manufacturing
Campaign missions and skirmish matches
Early alpha by a solo developer

click-to-build.intro: A kit of building tools that all work the same way: hover, see a live preview, click to place. No dragging, sizing or rotating by hand. Undo and redo everywhere, and the result can be unioned on finish.
features: 23 shapes placed with two clicks: footprint, then height
Walls, roads and fences along lines and curves, with four corner styles and editable points
Any Part or Model as a repeating template, with Magic Merge closing the seams
Stamp extrudes off any face, Voxel stacks or carves grid cells
Punch, Katana, Laser, Door, Nudger and Resizer for cutting and adjusting
Grid and surface snapping with live measurements

city-builder.intro: Author auto-layout procedural models and generate city roads, zones and buildings. The Procedural Model dock gives parts, folders and models per-axis layout constraints, like Figma auto layout in 3D. The City Builder dock draws road networks and fills blocks with generated buildings.
features: Per-axis layout modes: fixed, pin, stretch, center and repeat
Resize the parent and the whole tree re-lays out
Templates serialize to a registry and regenerate at any size
Click-to-draw roads with curves, intersections, elevation, lane lines and crosswalks
Procedural skyscraper catalog: Art Deco, brutalist, cylindrical, tiered and more
Zone placement for procedurally filled city blocks

perf-auditor.intro: Audit a place for performance problems and watch live engine stats, three views in one dockable panel. Every finding explains how to verify it with Studio's own tools.
features: Audit the whole place or the selection and get a 0 to 100 score
Findings ranked by severity, each with a one-click Select
Undoable one-click fixes for the most common problems
Live FPS, timings, draw calls, triangles, memory and network, sampled every second
Remote traffic log during playtests with warnings for oversized and spammy packets

super-aligner.intro: Align, distribute and arrange parts, models and folders along any axis. The alignment tools Studio's own Align Tool is missing, each previewed on hover and applied in one undo step.
features: Align to Min, Center or Max along X, Y or Z
Distribute with equal gaps that respect each object's size
Arrays, mirrors and match-spacing that create copies
Arrange into grids, arcs, spirals and drawn paths
Viewport gizmos and Figma-style smart snap guides
Works on parts, whole models and folders, pivots preserved

terrain-tools.intro: Shape terrain around anything you build. Select parts or a whole model, pick a tool, preview the result see-through and apply in one undo step.
features: Convert parts to terrain, per part or merged into one landmass
Skirt terrain up to the underside of roads and platforms
Tunnel clearance above a path, flat or round
Flatten, Moat, Paint, Smooth and Cut Grass
Green and red see-through preview before anything changes

voxelizer.intro: Turn any part, model or union into voxels. Pick the model, set the block size, press Generate. Good for stylized builds, low-poly conversions and destructible props.
features: Blocks as separate parts or a generated MeshPart
True colors photographed off your own model, textures and decals included
Max colors groups look-alike shades
Real mesh silhouettes at four detail levels, with a roundness control
Solid or hollow, block sizes down to 0.05 studs, or any part as the block
Builds in place or beside the original with one undo

icon-snap.intro: Batch-screenshot models into transparent PNG icons, right inside Studio. Select any number of models or folders, snap them in one run, and save the results as PNG files named after each model.
features: Hundreds of models in one batch
Clean alpha-matted cutouts with anti-aliased edges
Shared camera framing with presets, exact auto-fit and a key light rig
Brightness, contrast, saturation and an optional outline
32 to 1024 px output
Stream to disk through a local companion, upload to Roblox, or export by hand

quick-actions.intro: A home for the little Luau snippets that are not worth a whole plugin. Save a bit of code, give it a name and icon, run it on your selection with one click, or pin it to the Studio toolbar.
features: Save and run small Luau actions from a docked panel
Pin any action to the toolbar as its own button
Star favorites and search by name
Actions sync across every place and Studio session
Ready-to-run examples: anchor, weld, snap to grid, set material, randomize colors and more
Your own code only. No loadstring, no require by asset id

material-picker.intro: Pick visuals from any part and paint them onto others. Transfer colors, materials and textures between parts with simple clicks, so new models match existing ones without copying property values by hand.
features: Pick mode samples color, material and textures from any part
Paint mode applies the picked visuals with a click
Visual preview of the selected properties
Works with any BasePart, including SurfaceAppearance and PBR textures

npc-outfit-creator.intro: Build NPC outfits visually from Marketplace asset ids with a live rig preview. No HumanoidDescription editing by hand.
features: Every clothing and accessory slot, several ids per slot
Body colors and avatar scaling within Roblox's limits
Live preview with friendly warnings for bad ids
Create a ready-anchored R15 NPC or apply to a selected one
Import any user's avatar by UserId or browse their friends
Unlimited named presets and a randomizer

grip-a-tool.intro: Preview and edit tool grip CFrames directly on a character. Select any Tool in the Workspace, see how it sits in a character's hand, and fine-tune the grip until it looks right.
features: Live grip preview with full undo and redo
Adjust the grip with Studio's own move and rotate tools
Preview during real animation playback, including any animation by asset id
Play, pause, frame stepping, loop and 0.1x to 2x speed
Find every Tool in the place
Preview on your own avatar or any character by username or id, R6 and R15

pose-a-dude.intro: Create posed characters as building elements. Place characters frozen at any animation frame, turn them into statues with decorative bases, or generate frame-by-frame sequences for dynamic displays.
features: Freeze at any frame with timeline scrubbing
Statuefy with customizable bases, materials and colors
Frame sequences that show animation progression
Live preview before dropping
Custom characters by username or id
Rotation, gravity and upright placement settings

drop-a-dude.intro: A scale-reference character that follows your camera, so you stop dragging that one scale dude around your builds. Drop fixed references wherever you need them, and the plugin removes them all when it closes.
features: Live preview that stays in view as you navigate
Drop as many fixed dudes as you need: R6, R15, Anthro or custom avatars
Automatic cleanup on close, so none end up in the published game
Reopen the plugin and they pop back into place
